name: Cable Saddle Clamp
description: 40 x 16 mm saddle clamp for a 10 mm cable: raised bridge with a through bore, two M4 screw holes, and chamfered top edges.

steps.instruction: Create the clamp base: a bar 40 mm long (X), 16 mm wide (Y) and 5 mm thick (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

steps.instruction: Add the saddle bridge: a block 20 mm long (X), the full 16 mm wide (Y) and 16 mm tall (Z), centered on the base and fused with it.

steps.instruction: Bore the cable channel through the bridge: a horizontal cylinder of radius 5 mm (10 mm cable) along the Y axis, centered at X=0, Z=9.

steps.instruction: Drill two M4 clearance holes of radius 2.2 mm vertically through the base at X = +/-15, Y=0.
